entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire, the highest ranking member of the Church of Dusk, who later leads vampires against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: Torrezon's clergy on Ixalan, led by the Pontifex.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where the Immortal Sun and Orazca are sought.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The home of the Church of Dusk's clergy.

entities.name: Elenda
entities.description: Guardian of the Immortal Sun who became a vampire and taught her Rite to the nobles; later a living saint.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact sought by the vampires, Sun Empire, pirates and others, later stolen by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The Golden City on Ixalan that holds the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Arguel
entities.description: A vampire on a blood fast whose desiccated corpse is found with the Hierophant's Chalice.

entities.name: Zotz
entities.description: A demon-spawn that nests in the Temple of Aclazotz and enthralls Mavren Fein.

entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: The temple where Zotz nested.

entities.name: Alante
entities.description: A cleric of the Order of the Five Sacraments who leads a party and claims the Hierophant's Chalice.

entities.name: Order of the Five Sacraments
entities.description: A religious order to which Alante belongs.

entities.name: Hierophant's Chalice
entities.description: A chalice that can provide an endless supply of blood.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: A vampire, Alante's sworn enemy, who later breaks away to form a splinter church.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A character thrown from the Tower of Triumph by Mavren.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Sun Empire leader who commands Mavren's release during the invasion.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The planeswalker who steals the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ghalta
entities.description: An elder dinosaur summoned to fight the Phyrexians.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Ixalan.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The Ixalan empire that captures Mavren and later releases him.

events.summary: Elenda becomes a vampire after the Immortal Sun is stolen and teaches her Rite to the nobles; Mavren Fein is an early convert.
events.quote: Mavren Fein was one of her early converts

events.summary: Mavren travels to Ixalan to find Orazca, guiding his ship by faith alone during his Blood Fast.
events.quote: He guided his ship to shore by faith alone

events.summary: Mavren falls under the thrall of the demon-spawn Zotz at the Temple of Aclazotz and goes slowly mad.
events.quote: Mavren fell under the thrall of the demon-spawn Zotz

events.summary: Alante's party battles Mavren and Zotz at the temple; Zotz's death breaks its hold on Mavren and Alante takes the Hierophant's Chalice.
events.quote: When Zotz was killed, its death finally broke its hold on Mavren

events.summary: Mavren joins Vona and reaches Orazca, throwing Kumena out of the Tower of Triumph.
events.quote: threw Kumena out of the window of the Tower of Triumph

events.summary: Tezzeret steals the Immortal Sun amid the struggle between four factions.
events.quote: the artifact was stolen by Tezzeret and removed from the plane

events.summary: Saint Elenda reappears and tells her followers they are free from their ancient duty; Mavren punishes Vona for speaking ill of her, and the Legion leaves Ixalan.
events.quote: Mavren Fein punished Vona for speaking ill of the living saint

events.summary: Fein returns to Ixalan, is captured by the Sun Empire, and is released under Huatli's command to invoke the Elder Dinosaurs against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: was captured by the Sun Empire

events.summary: Ghalta rampages among the Phyrexians and Mavren's vampire legionnaires follow in its wake, dealing serious damage to the invaders.
events.quote: Mavren commanded his legionnaires to follow in the elder dinosaur's wake

events.summary: After the Invasion Fein is promoted to Pontifex but Vona breaks away to form a splinter church.
events.quote: Fein was promoted to Pontifex of the Church of Dusk

relations.note: He is its highest ranking member.
relations.quote: is the highest ranking member of the Church of Dusk

relations.note: He was one of her early converts.
relations.quote: Mavren Fein was one of her early converts
Vona de Iedo , Alante's sworn enemy

relations.note: Alante is a cleric of the order.
relations.quote: the Order of the Five Sacraments cleric Alante

relations.note: Former allies until Vona breaks away.
relations.quote: his former ally Vona broke off and formed a splinter church
Mavren Fein remained enthralled by the demon for some amount of time
